## Activity

During June 2024, North City Eye Clinic recorded 586 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the clinic’s service. Capture volumes should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting so that any changes can be identified and considered alongside the quality and grading results.

## Image quality

Of the 586 captures, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.5 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be reviewed as part of ongoing quality monitoring. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and maintain consistent image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 155 referable results during June 2024. The median lag from capture to grading was 4 days. This provides the monthly measure of grading timeliness for North City Eye Clinic. Activity, image quality and grading results should be considered together when reviewing the clinic’s operational performance and identifying any issues requiring attention.
